c6_jail.exit.lead.02.synthesis_text: Ben’s a tree in the school play this afternoon. He’s been practising being a tree for a month.
c6_jail.exit.lead.02.previous_text: Sheriff. Steve. I’m supposed to stop you.

c6_jail.exit.lead.04.speaker: calder
c6_jail.exit.lead.04.text: The school doors close at four forty. Let’s find you the fastest way there.
c6_jail.exit.lead.04.synthesis_text: The school doors close at four forty. Let’s find you the fastest way there.
c6_jail.exit.lead.04.next_text: Bus A. Twenty-nine past. They gave me a seat in the front row.

c6_jail.in.04.speaker: stephen
c6_jail.in.04.text: The Sheriff is out on the harbor, hunting you. The Sheriff is also in cell two. One of those is a staffing problem.
c6_jail.in.04.synthesis_text: The Sheriff is out on the harbor, hunting you. The Sheriff is also in cell two. One of those is a staffing problem.
c6_jail.in.04.previous_text: Stephen walked in the front door wearing my face, to contest his own poster. I came in the back, under the parcels in the mail cart.
c6_jail.in.04.next_text: I am required to report your location.

c6_jail.mail.03.speaker: steve
c6_jail.mail.03.text: Twenty-three across, where it crosses eight down. Only the woman in cell two will see that square.
c6_jail.mail.03.synthesis_text: Twenty-three across, where it crosses eight down. Only the woman in cell two will see that square.
c6_jail.mail.03.previous_text: June’s own crossword is in the jail pile. I’ll circle one square and post it through her slot.
c6_jail.mail.03.next_text: The key was in the Jail drawer, slot 9, where entries 17 and 18 share a slot. And on June’s crossword I circled the square where 23 Across crosses 8 Down. Only the woman in cell two will see it.

c6_jail.mail.find.next_text: Three tickets at the counter. Leave the deputy to me.

c6_jail.mail.lead.06.speaker: pell
c6_jail.mail.lead.06.text: County rule. When a cell is used, the spare key goes back to the clerk by registered post. The Sheriff wrote that rule. Her copy follows it exactly.
c6_jail.mail.lead.06.synthesis_text: County rule. When a cell is used, the spare key goes back to the clerk by registered post. The Sheriff wrote that rule. Her copy follows it exactly.
c6_jail.mail.lead.06.previous_text: Each slot holds two entries. Slot one holds entries one and two, and so on.
c6_jail.mail.lead.06.next_text: Correctly delivered. Biscuit may inspect the chain of custody.

c6_jail.recap.01.speaker: steve
c6_jail.recap.01.text: June is out of her cell, and her copy is out at the north jetty, looking for me. Pell chose a beagle over his orders. Lyle’s copy chose a school play.
c6_jail.recap.01.synthesis_text: June is out of her cell, and her copy is out at the north jetty, looking for me. Pell chose a beagle over his orders. Lyle’s copy chose a school play.
c6_jail.recap.01.previous_text: Lyle’s copy could still make Ben’s play: Bus A at 4:29, at the school by 4:38. He chose the front row over his orders, and let us go.
c6_jail.recap.01.next_text: Five fugitives and a beagle. We needed a car nobody would look for.

c6_jail.recap.03.speaker: steve
c6_jail.recap.03.text: Iris was waiting behind Gus’s bakery next door, where nobody would see Nora’s face.
c6_jail.recap.03.synthesis_text: Iris was waiting behind Gus’s bakery next door, where nobody would see Nora’s face.
c6_jail.recap.03.previous_text: Five fugitives and a beagle. We needed a car nobody would look for.
c6_jail.recap.03.next_text: Take the van. I don’t know why, but I trust you.

c7_gate.in.03.speaker: steve
c7_gate.in.03.text: We spent Tuesday in the back room of Gus’s bakery, planning on flour sacks.
c7_gate.in.03.synthesis_text: We spent Tuesday in the back room of Gus’s bakery, planning on flour sacks.
c7_gate.in.03.previous_text: Sentinel Point. An old antenna field in the fog north of town, flags on every mast, and the President of the United States due at noon.
c7_gate.in.03.next_text: We couldn’t call anyone. The FBI’s man at the signing was Rook’s copy, and Rook’s list had names in Washington.

c7_gate.in.04.speaker: steve
c7_gate.in.04.text: We couldn’t call anyone. The FBI’s man at the signing was Rook’s copy, and Rook’s list had names in Washington.
c7_gate.in.04.synthesis_text: We couldn’t call anyone. The FBI’s man at the signing was Rook’s copy, and Rook’s list had names in Washington.
c7_gate.in.04.previous_text: We spent Tuesday in the back room of Gus’s bakery, planning on flour sacks.
c7_gate.in.04.next_text: So we used what we had. Halcyon runs the sound for the signing, Stephen still has their crew pass, and Dad’s tape has the tone.

c7_gate.in.05.speaker: steve
c7_gate.in.05.text: So we used what we had. Halcyon runs the sound for the signing, Stephen still has their crew pass, and Dad’s tape has the tone.
c7_gate.in.05.synthesis_text: So we used what we had. Halcyon runs the sound for the signing, Stephen still has their crew pass, and Dad’s tape has the tone.
c7_gate.in.05.previous_text: We couldn’t call anyone. The FBI’s man at the signing was Rook’s copy, and Rook’s list had names in Washington.
c7_gate.in.05.next_text: June wrote to the President in her own hand. Pell would deliver it the way he delivers everything: into the right hand, on time.

c7_gate.in.06.speaker: steve
c7_gate.in.06.text: June wrote to the President in her own hand. Pell would deliver it the way he delivers everything: into the right hand, on time.
c7_gate.in.06.synthesis_text: June wrote to the President in her own hand. Pell would deliver it the way he delivers everything: into the right hand, on time.
c7_gate.in.06.previous_text: So we used what we had. Halcyon runs the sound for the signing, Stephen still has their crew pass, and Dad’s tape has the tone.
c7_gate.in.06.next_text: Gus had two catering passes for the press tent. June and Iris would use them at the red window, at ten past eleven, on foot, in his aprons and hairnets, carrying croissants.

c7_gate.in.07.speaker: steve
c7_gate.in.07.text: Gus had two catering passes for the press tent. June and Iris would use them at the red window, at ten past eleven, on foot, in his aprons and hairnets, carrying croissants.

c7_gate.in.07.previous_text: June wrote to the President in her own hand. Pell would deliver it the way he delivers everything: into the right hand, on time.
c7_gate.in.07.next_text: Crew credentials. Loyal asset. Very important face.

c7_gate.recap.03.speaker: steve
c7_gate.recap.03.text: June and Iris were already inside, in hairnets, somewhere near the service tunnel. Iris knew the crew’s routes. She used to walk them.
c7_gate.recap.03.synthesis_text: June and Iris were already inside, in hairnets, somewhere near the service tunnel. Iris knew the crew’s routes. She used to walk them.
c7_gate.recap.03.previous_text: Ward signed for Pell’s letter at 11:54, with a fresh bandage on her left wrist. The public ceremony starts at 11:58.
c7_gate.recap.03.next_text: If they swap her, it happens between the hatch and the podium.

c7_swap.ctx.03.speaker: steve
c7_swap.ctx.03.text: At ten to twelve, the earpiece in Stephen’s hand stopped asking him for reports. It asked for me, by name.
c7_swap.ctx.03.synthesis_text: At ten to twelve, the earpiece in Stephen’s hand stopped asking him for reports. It asked for me, by name.
c7_swap.ctx.03.previous_text: If it played on every speaker at once, every copy on the site would answer it at once. In front of everybody.
c7_swap.ctx.03.next_text: Your parents’ records are in good order, Mr. Mercer. So is mine. I have never been wrong on the record. Not on Tirel, and not here.

c7_swap.tone.04.speaker: calder
c7_swap.tone.04.text: She has my letter. She read it by flashlight in the tunnel, and she believes us. She wants to meet the man at the sound desk.
c7_swap.tone.04.synthesis_text: She has my letter. She read it by flashlight in the tunnel, and she believes us. She wants to meet the man at the sound desk.
c7_swap.tone.04.next_text: At 11:58:15 Dad’s tone went out on every site speaker. Fourteen people stopped and turned toward the sea, the woman at the microphone among them. June and Iris had the real President.
